bibliographic.title: A Spy's Heist
bibliographic.author: dott. Piergiorgio
bibliographic.description:
There are no margin for doubts: A certain foreign Consulate is actively engaged in corrupting our public officials, not only for the usual intelligence gathering, but also for favoring their country's export.
But, first and foremost, we need to get solid and unquestionable evidence.
This means infiltrating their Consulate for getting the needed evidence, and toward this end, we manage to infiltrate the consulate, and one of our best agent is there, working undercover as a maid.
Wasn't an easy work for our Services, but in the end, now you're here.

(A short 'appetizer' released in the run-up to IFComp 2026.)
